summary: First-finish smoke test. Backend endpoints validated end-to-end (auth, suppliers, medicines CRUD, CSV+paste import, users, logs create/assign/list, exports text+PDF, RBAC 401/403, privacy on employee suggest). Frontend admin login → /admin kanban rendered with columns and action buttons; employee login → /employee, notes visible, role guard blocks /admin. Ready for user review.
passed: Admin login returns JWT token; /api/auth/me returns admin identity
Admin creates supplier; list returns it
Admin creates medicine with default_supplier_id; list decorates default_supplier_name
CSV import via multipart parses 'Medicine Name,Company,Default Supplier' header and auto-creates suppliers (added:2)
Paste import auto-detects header and creates supplier (added:1)
Admin creates employee user; employee can log in and receive employee-role token
Employee POST /api/logs with known name (case-insensitive) auto-links medicine_id, company, supplier_id, status=assigned
Employee POST /api/logs with unknown name → supplier_id=null, status=unassigned
Employee GET /api/logs returns only own entries; admin GET /api/logs returns all
Admin PUT /api/logs/{id}/assign with supplier_id moves to that supplier; with null returns to unassigned
GET /api/logs/export/text returns grouped text with '*SupplierName*' sections and 'Qty left: N' lines
GET /api/logs/export/pdf returns Content-Type application/pdf and valid %PDF bytes
Employee gets 403 on POST /api/suppliers, POST /api/medicines, GET /api/users, PUT /api/logs/{id}/assign
Frontend / redirects to /login; login-form testids work
Admin login redirects to /admin; kanban-board, date-picker, copy-all-btn, download-pdf-btn all visible
Employee login redirects to /employee; role guard redirects /admin → /employee
Employee page renders notes list with existing logs (UnknownMedXYZ, Paracetamol500) with quantities

failed.issue: POST /api/logs rejects integer quantity with 422 (schema requires string). Frontend must send string; may confuse API consumers.
failed.evidence: Sending {"quantity":5} returned pydantic string_type error; {"quantity":"5"} succeeded.

failed.issue: is_visible('[data-testid="employee-medicine-input"]') returned False on /employee even though input is rendered (visible in screenshot). Testid may be on a wrapper element, not the input, or async render delayed. Non-blocking for users but may impact automated tests.
failed.evidence: Screenshot .screenshots/employee_home2.png shows input; selector visibility check false.

action_items: Optional: accept both int and string for POST /api/logs quantity (or coerce), and ensure Pydantic model documents string type
Optional: place data-testid='employee-medicine-input' directly on the <input> element (not a wrapper) for reliable Playwright targeting
